claims.evidence: Photo 0 cover shows the title HITMAN 2 and PS4 text.
The report states whether the game disc is inside the case is not shown.
The report states physical condition of the case and disc are not shown.

risks.risk: The case may be empty with no disc inside.
risks.proof: A photo showing the disc inside the case or the disc removed with its label visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an empty case with no disc.

risks.risk: The disc may be scratched or damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the disc's data surface.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a damaged or unreadable disc.

risks.risk: The plastic case may be cracked, scuffed, or worn.
risks.proof: Photos of the case from multiple angles showing its condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a worn or damaged case.

risks.risk: Instruction manual or inserts may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included manuals and inserts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as case and disc only.

risks.risk: The game may not have been tested and may not function.
risks.proof: A video of the game installing and running on a PS4.

risks.risk: The game region may not be compatible with the buyer's console.
risks.proof: A photo of the region code on the case or disc, or a screenshot confirming region.

proof_requests: Photo showing the disc inside the case.
Close-up photo of the disc surface.
Photos of the case condition from all sides.
Photo of any manuals or inserts.
Video of the game running on PS4.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Hitman 2 PS4 game, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's claims about a neatly used disc are unverified and do not block pricing.
